relations.subject: G. S. Gai

relations.evidence: the Epigraphical Branch of the Archaeological Survey of India was shifted from Ootacamund to Mysore in June 1966 when Dr. G. S. Gai was its Head as Government Epigraphist for India... retired from service in March 1976
